thought
Aha!! "Sites have only so many places where drones can take off and land at the same time."
Let's see what else they know about drones, sensors, loads, batteries, corridors, maintenance/technicians, airspace!
Let's ask what makes a drone eligible or able to take on a specific delivery or inspection job (e.g., load, sensors, battery, location, readiness).What determines whether a particular drone can take on a given delivery or inspection job and get to where the job starts?
